task.description:
Design three ISS items for WF02 batch. Write THREE prose design docs (Type E):

1. src/design/iss207_error_retry_convergence.md
   ISS-207: Convergent EXECUTION_ERROR retry. Re-presenting same trigger to deterministic engine = same error (no progress).
   - retry requires a changed cause: new definition version OR authorised correction event; bare no-op retry rejected with hint.
   - retry-with-input: re-presents trigger with operator-supplied corrected payload.
   - discard: terminates instance as CANCELLED.
   Touchpoints: src/engine/instance.zig, src/dlq/store.zig, src/api/routes/dlq.zig

2. src/design/iss208_guard_task_completion.md
   ISS-208: Guard task completion against terminal instances.
   - complete() returns 409 if parent instance is not ACTIVE.
   - Guard enforced inside the transaction (race-safe), not just a pre-check.
   Touchpoints: src/tasks/store.zig, src/api/routes/tasks.zig

3. src/design/iss205_webhook_transactional_outbox.md
   ISS-205: Webhook transactional outbox (true at-least-once).
   - webhook_deliveries rows inserted IN SAME TRANSACTION as the event (ISS-106 table already exists).
   - Worker pool claims due/PENDING rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
   - In-process notify is latency optimisation only; periodic+startup sweep drains orphans.
   - Back-off ladder: 5s,30s,2m,10m,30m / 5 attempts; final failure pauses subscription + fires OBS-06.
   - Kill-after-commit test must still deliver webhook on restart.
   Touchpoints: src/webhook/dispatcher.zig, route handlers

No implementation code. Prose signatures and behaviour only.
acceptance_criteria: iss207 design: retry/retry-with-input/discard flows described, changed-cause check specified
iss208 design: transactional guard described, 409 path specified
iss205 design: transactional outbox insert path, worker claim, back-off ladder, OBS-06 trigger all described
No implementation code in any design doc

result.summary: Three Type E prose design docs written for ISS-207, ISS-208, and ISS-205.
